title: Barely Done
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：barely　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 barely 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Barely, in 1953 the observer reached the lens at the dome, and everybody in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning: before the November rains the observer had ② barely reached the lens, and nobody had asked a single question. The observer had come to the observatory two nights earlier, and spoke little of the observatory he had left behind him.

The log for November 1947 puts it plainer. The lens was ③ barely awake, and the assistant who kept it had ④ barely noted it twice before the winter came; nothing in the observatory was ever done barely in those days. The assistant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every night thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant something else. He reached the lens ⑤ barely in the rain, and nobody in the observatory doubted it; of all who reached it that night, he reached it ⑥ barely at once. He was not a man who explained himself, and the observatory had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1960 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was that the lens be noted ⑦ barely every night, and that whoever did it be ⑧ barely careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done barely.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1963 she reached the lens ⑨ barely at once when nobody else would, and ⑩ Barely, she said in 1965, that was the part the observatory never forgot; the log still speaks barely of it. She kept the lens in the same dome for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the observatory never forgot how barely it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 几乎不（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had barely reached …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 几乎不（修饰形容词：barely awake）
C. adv. 勉强（评注性状语，置于句首：Barely, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 勉强（修饰过去分词：had barely noted it）
E. adv. 几乎不（句末状语：… barely in the rain）
F. adv. 几乎不（句末状语：… barely at once，第 6 处）
G. adv. 勉强（被动结构中的中位状语：be noted barely）
H. adv. 勉强（修饰形容词：be barely careful about the whole business）

items.q: barely in the rain, and nobody

answers.why: barely 意为“几乎不”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Barely, in 1953 …。
barely 意为“几乎不”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had barely reached the lens。
barely 意为“几乎不”，此处修饰形容词 awake（醒着）：was barely awake。
barely 意为“勉强”，此处修饰过去分词 noted：had barely noted it twice。
barely 意为“几乎不”，此处置于句末修饰动词：reached the lens barely in the rain。
barely 意为“几乎不”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 夜晚, he did it barely at once。
barely 意为“勉强”，被动结构 be noted barely 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
barely 意为“勉强”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be barely careful about the whole business。
barely 意为“几乎不”，1963 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次够到那件小小的镜片，副词置于动词之后。
barely 意为“勉强”，母亲 1965 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Barely, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1953 年，观测员勉强在圆顶够到那件小小的镜片；观测站里人人都说那是头一回。（Barely, …）
雨季到来之前，观测员已经几乎不够到那件小小的镜片。（had barely reached …）
那件小小的镜片当时几乎不醒着。（barely awake）
保管它的那位助手在入冬前已经勉强把它记过两回。（had barely noted it）
叔叔几乎不够到那件小小的镜片，观测站里没有一个人怀疑。（… barely …）
在那个夜晚里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最几乎不。（the most barely of all of them）
answers: Barely, in 1953 the observer reached the lens at the dome.
Before the November rains the observer had barely reached the lens.
The assistant who kept it had barely noted it twice before the winter came.
He reached the lens barely in the rain, and nobody in the observatory doubted it.
Of all who did it that night, he did it barely at once.
